name: L.S.D.s --- AKA: Love-Sucking Demons
source:
When Special Agent Fox spies an alien tormenting his main squeeze, he turns his reconnaissance assignment into a personal vendetta.

Set in the backdrop of the Stonewall Riots, this retro 1960's sci-fi thriller in the stylings of Jean-Luc Godard's Alphaville definitively answers the question, "Is surf rock still the bee's knees???"

[From [url=https://vimislikart.itch.io/lsds]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当福克斯特工发现一名外星人正在折磨他的主要对手时，他将自己的侦察任务变成了个人恩怨。

这部复古1960年代科幻惊悚片以石墙骚乱为背景，采用让-吕克·戈达尔 (Jean-Luc Godard) 的《阿尔法城》(Alphaville) 风格，明确回答了“冲浪摇滚仍然是最流行的吗？？？”这个问题。

[来自[url=https://vimislikart.itch.io/lsds]itch.io[/url]]
